opencode-quick-connect.title: Connect local OpenCode
opencode-quick-connect.intro: Check the local installation, configure a provider and fixed model, then explicitly connect.
opencode-quick-connect.desktop_required: Connect local OpenCode in the desktop app, or use an existing execution node.
opencode-quick-connect.storage_failed: The local configuration record could not be saved or read. Review the configuration before connecting; the original connection can still be checked or stopped.
opencode-quick-connect.version_unsupport: This installation version is unsupported. Follow the setup guide to prepare OpenCode 1.19.4, then check again.
opencode-quick-connect.verification_unav: This environment cannot verify the configuration. Check the desktop environment and try again. The original connection can still be checked or stopped.
opencode-quick-connect.credential_hint: Enter only the name of an existing local environment variable, never its secret value.
opencode-quick-connect.model_hint: Enter the model ID explicitly. This form does not read a model directory. Consult execution records for the actual model, usage and cost.
opencode-quick-connect.draft_not_adopted: This draft has not been confirmed as applied. Check the original connection first. To change its configuration, confirm it has stopped and then explicitly connect.
